description:
Activate Shalai by paying {4}{G}{G}, putting two +1/+1 counters on each creature you control.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat.
